name: Find App LLM audio engine startup order

text:
I need to verify a theory about iOS audio engine startup ordering in a Flutter monorepo at /Users/jace/Documents/newapp.

Context: The user claims that in `packages/core/core_audio/lib/src/impl/default_interpretation_audio_engine.dart` (around line 67), the startup order is:
1. flutter_sound TTS player start (creates AVAudioEngine)
2. record mic input start
3. AVAudioSession configure + activate (including Bluetooth SCO routing)

And claims this causes flutter_sound's iOS AVAudioEngine to be created BEFORE the final AVAudioSession category/mode/route (playAndRecord/voiceChat + Bluetooth SCO) is established, causing native render callbacks to silently die on the first session after a fresh app launch, but work fine on subsequent sessions within the same process because AVAudioSession config Persists.

I need you to:
1. Read `packages/core/core_audio/lib/src/impl/default_interpretation_audio_engine.dart` in full and report the EXACT order of operations in whatever method starts the audio engine (open/start), including exact line numbers, and quote the relevant code.
2. Determine whether `feature_app_llm` (the App LLM feature, not the interpretation/translate feature) actually uses `DefaultInterpretationAudioEngine`, or has its own separate audio engine implementation. Search for the class that logs "[AudioEngine] start (profile=" and "[AppLlmCtrl] audio engine starting"/"audio engine started" - find the actual file(s) involved and quote the exact startup sequence (order of: flutter_sound/TtsOutput start, mic/RecordMicPcmInput start, AudioSession configure/activate calls), with line numbers.
3. Look at how `record` package's iOS audio session ownership is configured currently - is there any call to `manageAudioSession(false)` or similar, or does `record` currently manage its own AVAudioSession? Search for "manageAudioSession" and "AVAudioSession" and "audio_session" package usage across `packages/core/core_audio`.
4. Check what version of the `record` package is pinned in pubspec.yaml files (search for "record:" in pubspec.yaml under packages/core/core_audio), to see if manageAudioSession(false) API (said to require record 7.1.1+) is even available.
5. Read any existing comments/docstrings in the audio engine file(s) that discuss WHY the current start order (TTS before mic before session activation) was chosen - there may be historical rationale already documented (e.g. referencing compatibility constraints).

Report back with exact file paths, line numbers, and quoted code for all of the above so I can evaluate whether the user's proposed theory and fix (reordering to: audio_session activate first, then mic with manageAudioSession(false), then TTS player last) is technically accurate and safe to implement.
正在调查 iOS 音频引擎启动顺序，先从相关实现文件与引用处入手。
